title: Indias External Debt
definition: India's external debt refers to the total stock of residents' liabilities to non-residents, repayable in foreign currency, goods, or services, comprising both sovereign and non-sovereign obligations.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for both Prelims (data points, composition, sustainability metrics like Debt-to-GDP ratio) and Mains (GS Paper III - Indian Economy, macroeconomic stability, capital account convertibility, and vulnerability to global shocks).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of India's External Debt.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
